phrase: Daisy, Daisy, give me your answer do
_comment: Canonical reference for the 'Daisy, Daisy' regression anchor (ARCH §10 P1). word_boundaries_after lists the indices into arpabet_with_stress AFTER which a word ends (so ['Daisy', 'Daisy', 'give', 'me', 'your', 'answer', 'do'] = 7 words = 6 internal boundaries, plus the implicit final boundary).
